preconditions.description: The number of strings k must be between 1 and 26 inclusive.
The length of the string q must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in q)
preconditions.description: The string q must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: If a beautiful sequence exists, output 'YES' followed by k strings; otherwise, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: any(s[0] != s[1] for s in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: The first characters of the strings in the beautiful sequence must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines()[1:] == [s for s in stdout.splitlines()[1:] if s]
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly k non-empty strings that concatenate to form q.
